browserEvidence.scope: Actual ROM chooser and automatic catalogs for all three sources; native audio rendering, timeline, physical source navigation, canonical preview/import, one Undo/Redo, visible note edit, portable download/reopen, 64-update excerpt ROM build, full-height narrow layout and zero page errors.
limits: Headless Chromium and phone viewport do not prove physical-device operation or hardware/listening equivalence.
Native audition is controlled subroutine execution, not natural gameplay. Editable conversion is a finite frame-end adaptation, not exact native synthesis.
Source ROMs and native PCM are never saved in this report.

Longer excerpts can exceed the generated scene viewer budget; the estimate covers Audio data only.

audioDriverSurvey.scope: Bounded executed base-APU writer observations; no automatic whole-library detection, engine identification or editable score conversion.
audioDriverSurvey.ownership: Existing RERuntime and RERuntimeUI; project schema 12 and canonical Audio remain unchanged.

gateCorrections.registryInventory: Two retained UI cardinality assertions now require eight installed profiles instead of five; the five original IDs are explicitly preserved and all three new profiles must remain unknown for the unrelated fixture. Case counts and all unrelated assertions are retained. The native profiles use the registry’s required probe/handler context signatures, verified against all three known ROMs and an unrelated source.
gateCorrections.reason: Automatic catalog discovery used the same pending WebCrypto path as Runtime Investigation and interfered with its cancellation fixture. Discovery now uses the existing independent SHA-256 helper. All 24 retained runtime cases and a new isolation regression pass unchanged.

nativeAudioLibrary.comparison: Exact APU address/value/source/cycle sequence and Float32 PCM against the committed unchanged parent CPU/APU in the same controlled initial state. Not natural-game or hardware equivalence.
nativeAudioLibrary.conversion: Finite frame-end APU-state adaptation; nearest canonical pitches, volume rows and simple duty instruments. DPCM, short-mode noise, sub-frame articulation, phase and original instrument/control-flow reconstruction remain outside editable conversion.
